beats.headline: Stop charging 18% on ₹7,000 rooms.
beats.say: Beta, tera hotel guest nahi kho raha... paisa teen jagah se leak ho raha hai. Teen jagah se, Kaka?

beats.label: SEND THIS TO YOUR FRONT DESK
beats.headline: Leak 1: room up to ₹7,500 a night is 5% GST. Above ₹7,500, 18%.

beats.label: LEAK 2 · GUEST FROM DELHI?
beats.headline: Still 2.5% CGST + 2.5% SGST. Your hotel's state decides, not the guest's.

beats.label: LEAK 3 · HAND MATHS
beats.headline: Rizstay splits CGST + SGST on every bill. GST register exports to Excel.

beats.label: BABLU KA HOTEL · EP 3 SOON
beats.headline: Comment GST. Free room-GST cheat sheet in your DMs.
beats.say: Kaka, aaj aath baje ghar! Shabaash, beta!
